newsitem.title: USA: Phil Fed area manufacturing slows, but prices jump.
newsitem.headline: Phil Fed area manufacturing slows, but prices jump.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia said Thursday that manufacturing activity in its region slowed drastically in September, but prices paid by factories for raw materials almost quadrupled.
The Philadelphia Fed's diffusion index of business activity in the manufacturing sector fell to 13.9 in September from 21.5 in August.
However, its index of prices paid by manufacturers jumped to 18.0 from 4.6 percent the precious month, according to the monthly outlook survey.
The mixed data point to slow, moderate growth for the regional economy, Michael Trebing, an economist at the Philadelphia Fed, said in a teleconference with reporters.
"The future index numbers and the responses we get regarding forecasts for the next six months are consistent with the stories of slow, moderate growth," he said.
"I think that's consistent with the story of somewhat slower, slower than moderate, growth in the next six months."
The 30-year Treasury bond fell 16/32, raising its yield to 7.06 percent from 7.01 percent at Wednesday's close.
